scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --resolveJsonModule --allowSyntheticDefaultImports --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --types node,vitest/globals src/index.ts test/*.test.ts
scripts.predeploy: node scripts/validate-deploy-config.mjs wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/validate-persisted-secrets.mjs --config wrangler.jsonc --allowlist deploy-secret-allowlist.json
scripts.deploy:first: node scripts/validate-deploy-config.mjs wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/validate-persisted-secrets.mjs --config wrangler.jsonc --allowlist deploy-secret-allowlist.json --allow-missing-worker && wrangler deploy
